verdict: 1701 LOD0 split faces in 85 bone sets (73 pairs, 12 triples) and 99 bone-set × slot groups; 230 cross-part seams. 1670 faces resolve by summed weight; 31 are three-bone ties at slots 7 (19), 17 (12), all with a 2:1 or 3:0 part-level vertex majority (weapons 31).

convention.split_face: the three points do not share one unique >= 0.5 owner
convention.weight: sum of the point's bone weight over the face's three points
convention.margin: best candidate weight minus second candidate weight
convention.part_hint: body, wheel_f_l/r/l/r, weapons, jet, aero_flaps from the bone name
convention.bone_set: sorted distinct owner bone names; 2 or 3 per split face
convention.assignment: larger summed weight; a tie uses the part with more of the three vertices
